newsitem.title: USA: Iron Mountain to acquire Safesite Records Management.
newsitem.headline: Iron Mountain to acquire Safesite Records Management.

text.p: Iron Mountain Inc. said Thursday it has a definitive agreement to acquire Safesite Records Management Corp. for $50 million in stock and $12 million in cash.
Iron Mountain is the nation's largest records management company, providing services such as the storage and management of paper documents in 33 U.S. markets.
Safesite, a closely held company based in Boston, is believed to rank fourth in the industry, with operations in 14 U.S. markets.
The number of Iron Mountain shares to be issued will be determined based on the stock's market price, the company said.
The merger is expected to close during the second quarter, it said.
Boston-based Iron Mountain's stock rose 75 cents to $27.875 on Nasdaq in late trading.
